description: This file is a Perl script that generates target configuration and profile makefiles for a build system, based on metadata input. It defines functions to process features, target names, versions, and configurations, and outputs structured configuration data in a specific format.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration flags based on a list of feature names.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Constructs a full target name including its parent, if any.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version string to a normalized format suitable for configuration naming.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Outputs configuration entries for a specified target, including features, dependencies, and version information.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two lists of packages into one, eliminating duplicates and resolving conflicts.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Generates a full target configuration file by processing metadata and outputting structured configuration data.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Creates a makefile snippet defining profile names and properties for a given target.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command line arguments and executes the appropriate generation functions.
